listing.summary: Hello, i made a mod that adds a hullmod that enables ship to "warp" directly into battle than just appear on bottom of the map. It works like warp beacon from sotf
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hullmod that enables ships to warp directly into battle instead of appearing on the bottom of the map.

description:
Hello, i made a mod that adds a hullmod that enables ship to "warp" directly into battle than just appear on bottom of the map.

It works like warp beacon from sotf

It works like this:

Changelog:

---1.1.2---

Tactical Jump Drive

*Fixed an issue where modular ships did not jump correctly at the start of battle. (looked silly)

-I’m planning to change how the teleport works so it feels better for a wider range of players. (need more ideas)

*Tactical Retreat Jump Drive

-Fixed an issue where retreat jump could make a ship disappear without properly counting it as retreated.

---1.1.1---

Now you can add an sMod that:

-Removes the movement and flux penalty at the start.

For 10 seconds:

-Flux dissipation +25%

-Shield turn rate +50%

-Shield raise/unfold speed +50%

Added new hullmod Tactical Retreat Jump Drive:

-Allows ships to retreat by tactical jump when ordered to retreat needs to have 0 flux and charge for for 2s/3s/4s/5s depending on hull size. No sMod for now (idk what effect)

---1.1.0---

Ships starts with flux depending on hull size 15%/25%/35%/50%

Ships are slower at jump for 1.4s/1.8s/2.3s/3.0s

Upon arrival, they deal minor damage to ships, fighters, and missiles and pushes them away.

Now should work as intended!!! Without deploying out of bounds of map

New visual effects.

Added ships spawn at 0.5-second intervals.

OP cost changes:

Frigate: 8 OP -->5 OP

Destroyer: 15 OP --> 12 OP

Cruiser: 22 OP --> 18 OP

Capital: 30 OP --> 25 OP

---1.0.0---

Idk just posted and kinda works ?

Download: (added as github rep to look "hackerish"

https://github.com/Drago551/MidBattleJump/releases/download/1.1.2/MidBattleJump.zip

aiDescription: Adds a hullmod that enables ships to warp directly into battle instead of appearing on the bottom of the map. It works like a warp beacon, allowing ships to jump in with visual effects and minor damage on arrival. Includes a tactical retreat option and optional sMods to adjust flux and shield penalties.
